data.name: 朱元璋模拟器
data.detailed_description:
From Commoner to Emperor – Write Your Own Founding History of the Ming Dynasty

The late Yuan Dynasty was an age of chaos, with warlords contending for supremacy. You are but one of countless commoners struggling to survive in this turbulent world – yet history would remember one name: Zhu Yuanzhang.

In Zhu Yuanzhang Simulator, you will walk the entire path from the dust of obscurity to the pinnacle of power. This is not a pre‑written chronicle, but a grand canvas painted by your own hand – every inch of land, every choice you make, every life‑or‑death gamble in the late Yuan and early Ming will be yours to command.

Rise and Fall in Chaotic Times – All Within a Single Thought

Will you join the Red Turban Army, building your reputation step by step amid the flames of war? Or will you navigate among the regional warlords, using strategy and rhetoric to shift the balance of power across the realm? Or perhaps you choose to lie low in the streets, honing your skills and biding your time until the moment is ripe?

Set against the grand historical backdrop of the late Yuan and early Ming, you play as Zhu Yuanzhang, fighting your way up from the lowest rung of society to become the founding emperor. But every step on this journey – whether to keep a low profile or show your mettle, to befriend heroes or go it alone – lies entirely in your hands.

Every Trade Has Its Master – Every Path Leads to the Top

You may choose different routes to achieve your hegemony:

  • As a General – join the rebel army, start as a centurion, earn merit on countless battlefields, and climb the ladder of power step by step.

  • As a Strategist – outmaneuver rivals with wisdom, form alliances or pit opponents against each other, and realise your ambitions through the hands of others.

  • As a Merchant – amass immense wealth, use your financial power to reshape the political landscape, and make the strongmen of the realm serve your ends.

  • As a Hermit – perfect your craft, befriend heroes far and wide, and emerge spectacularly when the time is right.

Whichever path you take, as long as you dare to think and dare to act, you will have the chance to carve out your own domain. You can even break free from the predetermined course of history – alter events long recorded in the annals. What if Guo Zixing had trusted you sooner? What if Chen Youliang had not made that fatal mistake at Lake Poyang? What if… history will be yours to rewrite.

The Realm and Its People – All in the Palm of Your Hand

From grand statecraft to the minutiae of personal life – you can scheme at court and win battles a thousand miles away; or you can travel incognito among the people, listening to their grievances. You may recruit talent from across the land, or nurture your own loyal followers and build a trusted inner circle.

Dozens of cities dot the map, and over a hundred historical figures each harbour their own ambitions. Every council meeting, every military campaign, every appointment or dismissal will shape the fate of your empire. You are no longer a bystander to history – you are the one who sets its wheel in motion.

Make History Yours

Zhu Yuanzhang Simulator is not a story already written – it is a living, breathing stage of chaos. You can choose to follow historical facts and experience the magnificent true life of Zhu Yuanzhang; or you can boldly strike out on your own – proclaim yourself king earlier, delay the northern expedition, ally with different powers – and write a founding history of the Ming that is entirely your own.

Each playthrough is a new age of turmoil; each choice is a turning point in history.

AI Mod Tool Support

This game is a template provided by FunloomAI, featuring AI Mod tools that let you instantly switch between different genres and expand with brand-new gameplay mechanics with just one click.
